title.en: the arboretum lights go on for the season.
title.de: die lichter im arboretum gehen an.

line.en: holiday at the arboretum opens wednesday 11 nov and runs to 3 jan; the evening lights are on from 17:00. the 12 days of christmas gazebos are in their last year.
line.de: holiday at the arboretum beginnt mittwoch 11.11. und läuft bis 3.1.; die abendlichter sind ab 17 uhr an. die 12-days-of-christmas-pavillons stehen dieses jahr zum letzten mal.
line.tr: holiday at the arboretum çarşamba 11 kasım'da açılıyor, 3 ocak'a kadar sürüyor; akşam ışıkları 17:00'den itibaren yanıyor. 12 days of christmas kameriyeleri bu yıl son kez.

sparks.why: Holiday at the Arboretum 2026 opens wed 11 nov through 3 jan 2027 per the Dallas Arboretum holiday page (dallasarboretum.org/holiday); 17:00 evening start from a 2026 ticketing guide (thrillzing.com). Some older pages still show 2025 dates and were not used.
